description: Source code for MIPI DBI SPI driver implementation in Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, data handling, and SPI communication functions.

methods.name: mipi_dbi_spi_write_helper
methods.description: Handles SPI write operations for different modes, including 3-wire and 4-wire configurations, with support for command and data transmission.

methods.name: mipi_dbi_spi_command_write
methods.description: Sends a command with optional data over SPI.

methods.name: mipi_dbi_spi_write_display
methods.description: Writes display buffer data over SPI.

methods.name: mipi_dbi_spi_command_read
methods.description: Reads data from the display via SPI, if read is required.

methods.name: mipi_dbi_spi_reset
methods.description: Performs hardware reset of the display via GPIO.

methods.name: mipi_dbi_spi_init
methods.description: Initializes the SPI device, configures GPIOs, and prepares for communication.
